answer: To register, an agent locks a work-escrow bond, released after verified service as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. funding-flow graph analysis exposes any agent caught running a cluster of identities off one wallet. Conviction means the entire bond is destroyed at once. Think of the bond as a juniper: locked, visible, forfeitable. The network watches every grove for a second identity on the same funds. Each fake needs its own meadow, and each meadow costs a full bond.
